answer.rationale: The proposal sends shipment IDs (C1) and delivery addresses (C2) to Parcelytics, making the integration C2 Confidential under DCS-01@v2#DC-3.1. All applicable rules are satisfied: (1) Vendor eligibility: under CT-PARCEL@v2, Parcelytics' DPA covers C1 and C2 data, satisfying SEC-POL@v3#SP-2.1, and no C3 data is sent (SEC-POL@v3#SP-2.2). (2) Data residency and regional annexes: all data subjects are in the US, so AX-EU@v1 and DRS-01@v1#DR-1 do not apply; processing in Parcelytics' contracted US region satisfies DRS-01@v1#DR-2. (3) Data in transit: mutual TLS is used, satisfying SEC-POL@v3#SP-3.1 directly without relying on waiver EXC-REG@2026-10#W-07. (4) Data at rest: 20-day retention is within the 30-day limit of SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.1, and encryption at rest satisfies SEC-POL@v3#SP-4.2. (5) Network and gateway: the service runs in Z2 and routes through int-gw, satisfying NET-STD@v2#NZ-1 and ADR-031@v1#D1; the egress proxy rule NET-STD@v2#NZ-2 applies only to Z3. (6) Change calendar: the planned go live date of 2026-11-09 is outside the 2026-12-14 to 2027-01-04 freeze window in CHG-CAL@2026#CF-1. With no violations and no conditions, the proposal is approved under ARB-CHARTER@v1#CH-3.4.
